description: Official modpack required to join the Create NoobCraft server. Lightweight, stable, and focused on Create-based multiplayer gameplay.
body:
# Create NoobCraft – Official Server Modpack

**Create NoobCraft** is the **official modpack required to join the NoobCraft server**.  
It includes all mods and dependencies needed to connect, play, and interact with the server’s Create-based world.

This pack is intentionally lightweight and focused — install it and you’re ready to join.

---

## Purpose of This Pack

This modpack exists to:
- Ensure all players have the **correct mods and versions**
- Provide a **stable multiplayer experience**
- Add **quality-of-life improvements** without unnecessary complexity
- Support gameplay centered around the Create mod

This is not a general-purpose modpack — it is specifically curated for the NoobCraft server.

---

## What to Expect on the Server

### ⚙️ Create-Based Gameplay
The server revolves around automation and engineering:
- Mechanical systems, factories, and logistics
- Rotational power and processing chains
- Additional Create integrations for expanded functionality

---

### 📦 Storage & Inventory
- Sophisticated Backpacks for portable, upgradeable storage
- Storage Drawers for efficient bulk storage
- Compatibility addons to integrate with Create

---

### 🧭 Travel & Exploration
- Waystones for fast travel between key locations

---

### 🔍 UI & Information
- Jade + Jade Addons for block/entity information
- Just Enough Items (JEI) for recipe lookup

---

### ⚡ Performance & Stability
- FerriteCore (memory optimization)
- ModernFix (performance and bug fixes)

Designed to keep gameplay smooth in multiplayer environments.

---

## Installation & Usage

1. Install this modpack via Modrinth
2. Launch using **NeoForge (Minecraft 1.21.1)**
3. Join the NoobCraft server

No additional setup required.

---

## Important Notes

- All mods in this pack are **required to join the server**
- Do not remove or modify mods
- Additional client-side mods may work but are not supported
- The mod list is intentionally minimal for stability and compatibility
